description: This file defines the 'Order' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Checkout' namespace. It contains methods for managing orders, including adding new orders, editing existing ones, deleting orders, and fetching order details. It interacts directly with the database to perform CRUD operations on order data, products, vouchers, totals, histories, and related entities.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents an order in the checkout process, providing methods to create, update, delete, and retrieve order details in the database.

methods.name: addOrder
methods.description: Inserts a new order into the database with provided data, then adds associated products, vouchers, and totals.

methods.name: editOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order with new data, merging existing order info where necessary, and managing associated order entities.

methods.name: deleteOrder
methods.description: Deletes an order from the database after voiding it and cleaning up related data such as products, vouchers, totals, histories, transactions, and rewards.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Fetches detailed order information from the database, including related country and zone info, and returns it as an associative array.

methods.name: editTransactionId
methods.description: Updates the transaction ID for a specific order.

methods.name: editOrderStatusId
methods.description: Updates the order status ID for a specific order.

methods.name: editComment
methods.description: Updates the comment associated with a specific order.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Inserts a product associated with an order into the database, including options and subscription details if applicable.

methods.name: deleteProducts
methods.description: Deletes one or more products from an order, also removing associated options and subscriptions.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all products associated with a specific order.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to a specific product within an order.

methods.name: deleteOptions
methods.description: Deletes options associated with a specific product in an order.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options for a specific product within an order.

methods.name: addSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription to a product within an order.

methods.name: deleteSubscription
methods.description: Removes a subscription from an order item.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves subscription details for a specific order item.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions based on filtering parameters.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersBySubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the total number of orders associated with a specific subscription.

methods.name: addVoucher
methods.description: Creates a voucher for an order and links it with a voucher record.

methods.name: deleteVouchers
methods.description: Deletes vouchers associated with an order.

methods.name: getVoucherByVoucherId
methods.description: Retrieves voucher details by voucher ID for a specific order.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Fetches all vouchers associated with an order.

methods.name: getVouchers
methods.description: Retrieves all vouchers associated with a specific order ID from the 'order_voucher' table.

methods.name: addTotal
methods.description: Inserts a new total record for an order, including extension, code, title, value, and sort order.

methods.name: deleteTotals
methods.description: Deletes all total records associated with a specific order ID from the 'order_total' table.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Fetches all total records for a given order ID, ordered by 'sort_order'.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds an entry to the order history, updating the order status, comment, notification, and whether to override.

methods.name: deleteHistory
methods.description: Deletes all history entries for a specific order ID.
